item.title: War Machine – Alan Ritchson goes up against an otherworldly killing machine in the new action sci-fi film
item.description: Directed by Patrick Hughes, the film stars Alan Ritchson, Dennis Quaid, Stephan James, Jai Courtney, Esai Morales, Keiynan Lonsdale, and Daniel Webber. During the final stage of U.S. Army Ranger selection, an elite team’s training exercise turns into a fight for survival against an unimaginable threat. War Machine hits Netflix on 6th March.

item.title: Review: Twinless – “a highly compelling and thought-provoking piece of filmmaking.”
item.description: If there’s a film you need to go in totally blind this year, make sure it’s Twinless.
